slides.headline: 5 things you probably missed on Nov. 24-25
slides.subline: **Space, courts, prices and mines.** Swipe for the quick version.

slides.body: China launched **Shenzhou-24** with a [[Pakistani astronaut]], the first foreigner on a Chinese crewed mission, AP and DW report.
A US jury convicted **Huawei** of conspiracy to steal trade secrets and bank fraud, but cleared it of [[racketeering]]. Huawei plans to appeal.
**Australia’s** inflation hit [[4.9%]] in the year to October, up from 4.3%, said the national statistics bureau. The Guardian reports.
Landmine Monitor counted [[6,929]] people killed or injured by mines in **2025**, the most since 2020. Myanmar and Syria were worst hit.
**Kilmar Abrego Garcia** left the US for Spain, lawyers said, ending a [[20-month]] legal fight. The Guardian and Al Jazeera report.
Which of these will matter most a year from now? Tell us below.
